workflow.name: Resize images in a folder
workflow.description: Shrinks every image in a folder to a max size with macOS sips. Originals stay; copies land in Artifacts.

nodes.label: Resize
nodes.command:
#!/bin/sh
# Resizes every image in a folder with macOS sips (no installs). Originals are kept.
set -eu
src="$HIVE_INPUT_FOLDER"
max="${HIVE_INPUT_MAX:-1600}"
out="$ARTIFACTS_DIR/resized"
mkdir -p "$out"
n=0
for f in "$src"/*; do
  case "$(printf %s "$f" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')" in
    *.png|*.jpg|*.jpeg|*.heic|*.webp|*.tif|*.tiff) ;;
    *) continue ;;
  esac
  sips -Z "$max" "$f" --out "$out/$(basename "$f")" >/dev/null
  n=$((n + 1))
done
echo "$n images resized to max ${max}px -> $out"
